No more of this!
If it has come to this, we strike each other.

With luck, I may live through it and land a blow upon him as well!

Careless.

I had been deceived. The enemy... had merely extended the point of his sword a little, without moving his body from its place.

Convinced that he had lunged at me, I had delivered my own sword into empty air. It merely skimmed the enemy's breastplate, doing no damage at all.

And then.

　そして。
